title: Inheritance and Composition: A Python OOP Guide
description: Learn how inheritance and composition in Python model is-a and has-a relationships, and when to use each to design flexible object-oriented code.
summary: In Python, understanding inheritance and composition is crucial for effective object-oriented programming. Inheritance allows you to model an is a relationship, where a derived class extends the functionality of a base class.
takeaways: Object-Oriented Python Live Course: Want to practice choosing between inheritance and composition in a real design?
By the end of this tutorial, you’ll understand that: Composition and inheritance in Python model relationships between classes, enabling code reuse in different ways.
Understanding how and when to apply each concept is key to leveraging the full power of Python’s object-oriented programming capabilities.
